have fn r49_expectation2(values, probs r49_two_point_vector) R = values(1) * probs(1) + values(2) * probs(2)

template<X, Y r49_two_point_vector, a, b R>:
    have fn r49_affine_coordinates(k N+: k <= 2) R = a * X(k) + b * Y(k)

have fn r49_affine_combine2(X, Y r49_two_point_vector, a, b R) r49_two_point_vector = \r49_affine_coordinates<X, Y, a, b>

thm r49_expectation2_affine:
    ? forall X, Y r49_two_point_vector, probs r49_two_point_vector, a, b R:
        r49_expectation2(r49_affine_combine2(X, Y, a, b), probs) = a * r49_expectation2(X, probs) + b * r49_expectation2(Y, probs)
    r49_expectation2(X, probs) = X(1) * probs(1) + X(2) * probs(2)
    r49_expectation2(Y, probs) = Y(1) * probs(1) + Y(2) * probs(2)
    have combined r49_two_point_vector = \r49_affine_coordinates<X, Y, a, b>
    r49_expectation2(combined, probs) = combined(1) * probs(1) + combined(2) * probs(2)
    \r49_affine_coordinates<X, Y, a, b>(1) = a * X(1) + b * Y(1)
    \r49_affine_coordinates<X, Y, a, b>(2) = a * X(2) + b * Y(2)
    combined(1) = a * X(1) + b * Y(1)
    combined(2) = a * X(2) + b * Y(2)
    r49_affine_combine2(X, Y, a, b) = combined
    combined(1) * probs(1) + combined(2) * probs(2) = (a * X(1) + b * Y(1)) * probs(1) + (a * X(2) + b * Y(2)) * probs(2)
    (a * X(1) + b * Y(1)) * probs(1) + (a * X(2) + b * Y(2)) * probs(2) = a * (X(1) * probs(1) + X(2) * probs(2)) + b * (Y(1) * probs(1) + Y(2) * probs(2))
    a * (X(1) * probs(1) + X(2) * probs(2)) + b * (Y(1) * probs(1) + Y(2) * probs(2)) = a * r49_expectation2(X, probs) + b * r49_expectation2(Y, probs)
